arguments.command:
set -e
network_types='nfs,nfs4,cifs,smbfs,sshfs,fuse.sshfs,9p,afpfs,ceph,glusterfs,davfs,fuse.rclone'
findmnt -rn -t "$network_types" -o TARGET,FSTYPE,SOURCE | while IFS= read -r line; do
  target=$(printf '%s' "$line" | awk '{print $1}')
  fstype=$(printf '%s' "$line" | awk '{print $2}')
  source=$(printf '%s' "$line" | cut -d' ' -f3-)
  printf '\nMount: %s  Type: %s  Source: %s\n' "$target" "$fstype" "$source"
  find "$target" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -printf '%M %u:%g %p\n' 2>/dev/null | sort
 done
